sentences.en: The heat of the furnace warmed the whole house.
sentences.zh: 炉子的热量暖和了整个房子。

sentences.en: I am the time and place beyond the furnace.
sentences.zh: 我存在于炉子之外的时间与地点。

sentences.en: I left my toolbox in the basement next to the furnace.
sentences.zh: 我把工具箱留在地下室靠近炉子的地方。

senses.zh: 熔炉，火炉,极热的地方,严峻的考验或磨难
